services.desc: The top 10 reasons The Upper Room is the ideal venue to hold your corporate event: Location, location, location: The “Simply Stunning” Upper Room is located in the heart of beautiful downtown Greenville, SC. Greenville is ranked as one of the Top 10 Best Downtowns in America. Your employees and staff will love spending time here. Ambience: The Upper Room is located in a beautiful, historic building built in the 1920’s. The brick walls, original hardwood floors, steel beams and light-filled windows create an inviting atmosphere to work and also to play.
